method: All 23 four-byte 0x25c hits in executable sections were checked against Ghidra disassembly and enclosing-function decompilation; classify the actual instruction and base object, not just the byte sequence.

other_object_field_hits.basis: These functions use +0x25c as an analysis/index field with +0x250/+0x260/+0x268/+0x270 relationships, not a CSMSFrame operand.

coverage: The 23 raw disp32/immediate byte candidates only; indirect addressing, block copies, other binaries and producer-side code are outside scope.
conclusion: No additional direct CSMSFrame+0x25c access was found among these 23 executable-byte candidates beyond the seven previously identified generic frame helpers. This does not establish the saved field's semantic identity or global non-use.
